batchRequest.request: Mark the earliest scholarship application submitted and add a reminder seven days before each remaining deadline.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, kpis, tabs])
header = CardHeader("Scholarship Application Tracker", "Deadlines, eligibility, documents and submission status")
kpis = SnippetCardBlock([k1, k2, k3, k4])
k1 = SnippetCardItem("total", k1l, k1r)
k1l = IconText(Icon("graduation-cap", "education"), "neutral", "m", "Total Applications", "This cycle", false, "horizontal")
k1r = BoldText("number", "6")
k2 = SnippetCardItem("submitted", k2l, k2r)
k2l = IconText(Icon("circle-check", "status"), "success", "m", "Submitted", "Awaiting decision", false, "horizontal")
k2r = BoldText("number", "2")
k3 = SnippetCardItem("progress", k3l, k3r)
k3l = IconText(Icon("pencil", "tools"), "warning", "m", "In Progress", "Drafting", false, "horizontal")
k3r = BoldText("number", "3")
k4 = SnippetCardItem("due", k4l, k4r)
k4l = IconText(Icon("clock", "time"), "danger", "m", "Due in 14 Days", "Needs attention", false, "horizontal")
k4r = BoldText("number", "2")
tabs = Tabs([tabOverview, tabDocs, tabEligibility])
tabOverview = TabItem("overview", "Overview", [overviewCallout, overviewTable])
overviewCallout = Callout("warning", "Upcoming deadline", "Gates Merit Scholarship is due on Nov 15 — two documents are still missing.")
overviewTable = Table([Col("Scholarship", names), Col("Award", awards), Col("Deadline", deadlines), Col("Status", statusTags)])
names = ["Gates Merit Scholarship", "STEM Leaders Grant", "Community Service Award", "First-Gen Scholars Fund", "Global Citizen Fellowship", "Arts & Humanities Prize"]
awards = ["$20,000", "$10,000", "$5,000", "$8,000", "$15,000", "$3,500"]
deadlines = ["2025-11-15", "2025-11-30", "2025-12-05", "2025-12-15", "2026-01-10", "2026-02-01"]
statuses = ["In Progress", "In Progress", "Submitted", "Submitted", "Not Started", "In Progress"]
statusTags = @Each(statuses, "s", Tag(s, null, "sm", s == "Submitted" ? "success" : s == "In Progress" ? "warning" : "neutral"))
tabDocs = TabItem("docs", "Required Documents", [docsAccordion])
docsAccordion = Accordion([a1, a2, a3])
a1 = AccordionItem("gates", "Gates Merit Scholarship", [d1])
d1 = EntityList([{left: "Official transcript", right: "Received"}, {left: "Two recommendation letters", right: "1 of 2"}, {left: "Personal essay (650 words)", right: "Draft"}, {left: "Financial aid form", right: "Missing"}])
a2 = AccordionItem("stem", "STEM Leaders Grant", [d2])
d2 = EntityList([{left: "Transcript", right: "Received"}, {left: "Research statement", right: "Draft"}, {left: "Faculty recommendation", right: "Requested"}])
a3 = AccordionItem("service", "Community Service Award", [d3])
d3 = EntityList([{left: "Service hours log", right: "Submitted"}, {left: "Supervisor reference", right: "Submitted"}, {left: "Short essay", right: "Submitted"}])
tabEligibility = TabItem("eligibility", "Eligibility Notes", [eligTable])
eligTable = Table([Col("Scholarship", names), Col("Eligibility Notes", notes)])
notes = ["Min GPA 3.7; full-time undergraduate; US citizen or permanent resident", "STEM major; sophomore or above; GPA 3.3+", "100+ verified volunteer hours in the past 2 years", "First-generation college student; demonstrated financial need", "Open to all majors; requires international experience or language study", "Humanities or arts majors; portfolio of 5 works required"]
request: Mark the earliest scholarship application submitted and add a reminder seven days before each remaining deadline.
